build_radius_graph: build a BiKNN radius graph for a single atomic system with soft or hard k-nearest neighbor ranking
build_radius_graph_chunked: build a chunked BiKNN radius graph to reduce peak memory for large atomic systems
batched_radius_graph: build batched BiKNN radius graphs for multiple atomic systems with padded neighbor tensors
biknn_radius_graph: build a BiKNN radius graph from an AtomicData object with automatic PBC image computation
segment_argsort_vectorized: compute argsort within each segment using a vectorized cumsum trick for ranking edges
